import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class SSP {
    int n, source, sink;
    List<List<Integer>> adj;
    static class Edge {
        int u, flow, cap, cost, origcost;
        Edge(int u, int flow, int cap, int cost, int origcost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.origcost = origcost;
        }
    }
    List<Edge> edges;

    SSP(int n, int source, int sink) {
        this.n = n;
        this.source = source;
        this.sink = sink;
        this.adj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    int addEdge(int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
        int result = edges.size();
        adj.get(a).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(b, 0, cap, cost, cost));
        adj.get(b).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(a, 0, 0, -cost, -cost));
        return result;
    }

    Pair<Integer, Integer> djk() {
        class State {
            int dist, prev, maxf;
        }
        PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
        State[] states = new State[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            states[i] = new State();
            states[i].dist = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            states[i].prev = -1;
            states[i].maxf = 0;
        }
        states[source].dist = 0;
        states[source].maxf = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        pq.offer(new int[]{0, source});
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] curr = pq.poll();
            int d = curr[0], v = curr[1];
            if (d != states[v].dist) continue;
            for (int edid : adj.get(v)) {
                Edge ed = edges.get(edid);
                if (ed.flow < ed.cap && states[ed.u].dist > states[v].dist + ed.cost) {
                    states[ed.u].dist = states[v].dist + ed.cost;
                    states[ed.u].prev = edid;
                    states[ed.u].maxf = Math.min(states[v].maxf, ed.cap - ed.flow);
                    pq.offer(new int[]{states[ed.u].dist, ed.u});
                }
            }
        }
        int lastid = states[sink].prev;
        int extraflow = states[sink].maxf;
        int atcost = 0;
        if (lastid == -1) return new Pair<>(0, 0);
        for (int id = lastid; id != -2; id = states[edges.get(id ^ 1).u].prev) {
            edges.get(id).flow += extraflow;
            edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= extraflow;
            atcost += edges.get(id).origcost;
        }
        for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
            int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
            int u = edges.get(id).u;
            if (states[v].prev != -1 && states[u].prev != -1) {
                edges.get(id).cost += states[v].dist - states[u].dist;
            }
        }
        return new Pair<>(extraflow, atcost);
    }

    Pair<Integer, Integer> mfmc() {
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        boolean hasNegativeCostEdge = false;
        for (Edge ed : edges) {
            if (ed.flow > 0 && ed.cost < 0) {
                hasNegativeCostEdge = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (hasNegativeCostEdge) bellamanford();
        while (true) {
            Pair<Integer, Integer> result = djk();
            int extraflow = result.first;
            int atcost = result.second;
            if (extraflow <= 0) break;
            flow += extraflow;
            cost += extraflow * atcost;
        }
        return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
    }

    void bellamanford() {
        int[] dist = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        dist[source] = 0;
        for (int rep = 0; rep < n; rep++) {
            boolean changed = false;
            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                Edge ed = edges.get(id);
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                int u = ed.u;
                if (ed.flow < ed.cap && dist[v] != Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && dist[u] > dist[v] + ed.cost) {
                    dist[u] = dist[v] + ed.cost;
                    changed = true;
                    assert rep < n - 1;
                }
            }
            if (!changed) break;
        }
        for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
            int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
            int u = edges.get(id).u;
            if (dist[v] < Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && dist[u] < Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2) {
                edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
            }
        }
    }
}

class Pair<F, S> {
    public F first;
    public S second;
    Pair(F first, S second) {
        this.first = first;
        this.second = second;
    }
}

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 2521;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int max_time = 120;

        int[][] to = new int[max_time][n + 1];
        for (int[] arr : to) {
            Arrays.fill(arr, -1);
        }

        int[] a = new int[k];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        List<List<Integer>> e = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            e.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            e.get(x).add(y);
            e.get(y).add(x);
        }

        int nd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                to[i][j] = nd++;
            }
        }

        int S = nd++;
        int T = nd++;

        SSP flow = new SSP(nd, S, T);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(S, to[0][a[i]], 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(to[i][1], T, k, c * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < max_time - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int kNeighbor : e.get(j)) {
                    for (int z = 0; z <= 52; z++) {
                        flow.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][kNeighbor], 1, d * (2 * z + 1));
                    }
                }
                flow.addEdge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][j], k, 0);
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> result = flow.mfmc();
        System.out.println(result.second);
    }
}
